# Precompute, run from cm_run_lobby_setup on a load whose cm_trmm_stamp is
# stale: computes each qualifying province definition's
# industry coverages definition-wide, stores them on every province slice in
# the definition along with the winning option indices and raw-input presence
# flags the tooltip breakdown chips read, and stores each location's best
# right index as a location variable, so the map mode and tooltip only read
# stored values. Variables stored on the province_definition itself do not
# read back, so everything is staged in locals and written to every slice.

			if = {
				limit = { local_var:cm_trmm_l_in_wine = 1 }
				set_variable = {
					name = cm_trmm_in_wine
					value = 1
				}
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { has_variable = cm_trmm_in_wine }
				remove_variable = cm_trmm_in_wine
			}
			if = {
				limit = { local_var:cm_trmm_l_in_wool = 1 }
				set_variable = {
					name = cm_trmm_in_wool
					value = 1
				}
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { has_variable = cm_trmm_in_wool }
				remove_variable = cm_trmm_in_wool
			}
			# Best right per location, encoded as round(score * 1000) * 10 + index so
			# the chained min = (raise-to-at-least) running maximum keeps both the score
			# and which right holds it. Higher index wins score ties, so index order is
			# the reverse of the priority order.
			every_location_in_province = {
				# Each right's score staged once: the encoding below, the tie count and
				# the runner-up chain all read these rather than the score chain itself.
				set_local_variable = {
					name = cm_trmm_l_r_tooling
					value = cm_trmm_right_tooling
				}
				set_local_variable = {
					name = cm_trmm_l_r_jewelry
					value = cm_trmm_right_jewelry
				}
				set_local_variable = {
					name = cm_trmm_l_r_naval
					value = cm_trmm_right_naval
				}
				set_local_variable = {
					name = cm_trmm_l_r_textile
					value = cm_trmm_right_textile
				}
				set_local_variable = {
					name = cm_trmm_l_r_weaponry
					value = cm_trmm_right_weaponry
				}
				set_local_variable = {
					name = cm_trmm_l_r_book
					value = cm_trmm_right_book
				}
				set_local_variable = {
					name = cm_trmm_l_r_artisan
					value = cm_trmm_right_artisan
				}
				set_local_variable = {
					name = cm_trmm_l_r_brewing
					value = cm_trmm_right_brewing
				}
				set_local_variable = {
					name = cm_trmm_l_r_masonry
					value = cm_trmm_right_masonry
				}
				set_local_variable = {
					name = cm_trmm_enc
					value = {
						value = 0
						min = {
							value = local_var:cm_trmm_l_r_tooling
							multiply = 1000
							round = yes
							multiply = 10
							add = 9
						}
						min = {
							value = local_var:cm_trmm_l_r_jewelry
							multiply = 1000
							round = yes
							multiply = 10
							add = 8
						}
						min = {
							value = local_var:cm_trmm_l_r_naval
							multiply = 1000
							round = yes
							multiply = 10
							add = 7
						}
						min = {
							value = local_var:cm_trmm_l_r_textile
							multiply = 1000
							round = yes
							multiply = 10
							add = 6
						}
						min = {
							value = local_var:cm_trmm_l_r_weaponry
							multiply = 1000
							round = yes
							multiply = 10
							add = 5
						}
						min = {
							value = local_var:cm_trmm_l_r_book
							multiply = 1000
							round = yes
							multiply = 10
							add = 4
						}
						min = {
							value = local_var:cm_trmm_l_r_artisan
							multiply = 1000
							round = yes
							multiply = 10
							add = 3
						}
						min = {
							value = local_var:cm_trmm_l_r_brewing
							multiply = 1000
							round = yes
							multiply = 10
							add = 2
						}
						min = {
							value = local_var:cm_trmm_l_r_masonry
							multiply = 1000
							round = yes
							multiply = 10
							add = 1
						}
					}
				}
				set_variable = {
					name = cm_trmm_best_idx
					value = {
						value = local_var:cm_trmm_enc
						modulo = 10
					}
				}
				# The encoding's score half: round(best score * 1000).
				set_variable = {
					name = cm_trmm_best_mil
					value = {
						value = local_var:cm_trmm_enc
						subtract = var:cm_trmm_best_idx
						divide = 10
					}
				}
				# Tie data for the stripes: 0 = no tie, 1-8 = the runner-up right of a
				# two-way tie for best, 10 = three or more tied. An exact-tied earlier
				# right would have won the encoding, so only later rights can be partners.
				set_variable = {
					name = cm_trmm_tie_idx
					value = 0
				}
				if = {
					# enc below 10 = best score rounds to 0.
					limit = { local_var:cm_trmm_enc >= 10 }
					if = {
						limit = { var:cm_trmm_best_idx = 9 }
						set_local_variable = {
							name = cm_trmm_l_ties
							value = {
								value = 0
								if = {
									limit = { local_var:cm_trmm_l_r_tooling = local_var:cm_trmm_l_r_jewelry }
									add = 1
								}
								if = {
									limit = { local_var:cm_trmm_l_r_tooling = local_var:cm_trmm_l_r_naval }
									add = 1
								}
								if = {
									limit = { local_var:cm_trmm_l_r_tooling = local_var:cm_trmm_l_r_textile }
									add = 1
								}
								if = {
									limit = { local_var:cm_trmm_l_r_tooling = local_var:cm_trmm_l_r_weaponry }
									add = 1
								}
								if = {
									limit = { local_var:cm_trmm_l_r_tooling = local_var:cm_trmm_l_r_book }
									add = 1
								}
								if = {
									limit = { local_var:cm_trmm_l_r_tooling = local_var:cm_trmm_l_r_artisan }
									add = 1
								}
								if = {
									limit = { local_var:cm_trmm_l_r_tooling = local_var:cm_trmm_l_r_brewing }
									add = 1
								}
								if = {
									limit = { local_var:cm_trmm_l_r_tooling = local_var:cm_trmm_l_r_masonry }
									add = 1
								}
							}
						}
						if = {
							limit = { local_var:cm_trmm_l_ties >= 2 }
							set_variable = {
								name = cm_trmm_tie_idx
								value = 10
							}
						}
						else_if = {
							limit = { local_var:cm_trmm_l_r_tooling = local_var:cm_trmm_l_r_jewelry }
							set_variable = {
								name = cm_trmm_tie_idx
								value = 8
							}
						}
						else_if = {
							limit = { local_var:cm_trmm_l_r_tooling = local_var:cm_trmm_l_r_naval }
							set_variable = {
								name = cm_trmm_tie_idx
								value = 7
							}
						}
						else_if = {
							limit = { local_var:cm_trmm_l_r_tooling = local_var:cm_trmm_l_r_textile }
							set_variable = {
								name = cm_trmm_tie_idx
								value = 6
							}
						}
						else_if = {
							limit = { local_var:cm_trmm_l_r_tooling = local_var:cm_trmm_l_r_weaponry }
							set_variable = {
								name = cm_trmm_tie_idx
								value = 5
							}
						}
						else_if = {
							limit = { local_var:cm_trmm_l_r_tooling = local_var:cm_trmm_l_r_book }
							set_variable = {
								name = cm_trmm_tie_idx
								value = 4
							}
						}
						else_if = {
							limit = { local_var:cm_trmm_l_r_tooling = local_var:cm_trmm_l_r_artisan }
							set_variable = {
								name = cm_trmm_tie_idx
								value = 3
							}
						}
						else_if = {
							limit = { local_var:cm_trmm_l_r_tooling = local_var:cm_trmm_l_r_brewing }
							set_variable = {
								name = cm_trmm_tie_idx
								value = 2
							}
						}
						else_if = {
							limit = { local_var:cm_trmm_l_r_tooling = local_var:cm_trmm_l_r_masonry }
							set_variable = {
								name = cm_trmm_tie_idx
								value = 1
							}
						}
					}
					else_if = {
						limit = { var:cm_trmm_best_idx = 8 }
						set_local_variable = {
							name = cm_trmm_l_ties
							value = {
								value = 0
								if = {
									limit = { local_var:cm_trmm_l_r_jewelry = local_var:cm_trmm_l_r_naval }
									add = 1
								}
								if = {
									limit = { local_var:cm_trmm_l_r_jewelry = local_var:cm_trmm_l_r_textile }
									add = 1
								}
								if = {
									limit = { local_var:cm_trmm_l_r_jewelry = local_var:cm_trmm_l_r_weaponry }
									add = 1
								}
								if = {
									limit = { local_var:cm_trmm_l_r_jewelry = local_var:cm_trmm_l_r_book }
									add = 1
								}
								if = {
									limit = { local_var:cm_trmm_l_r_jewelry = local_var:cm_trmm_l_r_artisan }
									add = 1
								}
								if = {
									limit = { local_var:cm_trmm_l_r_jewelry = local_var:cm_trmm_l_r_brewing }
									add = 1
								}
								if = {

									add = 1
								}
							}
						}
						if = {

								value = 10
							}

							value = {

									add = 1

								if = {
									limit = { local_var:cm_trmm_l_r_naval = local_var:cm_trmm_l_r_weaponry }
									add = 1
								}
								if = {
									limit = { local_var:cm_trmm_l_r_naval = local_var:cm_trmm_l_r_book }
									add = 1
								}
								if = {
									limit = { local_var:cm_trmm_l_r_naval = local_var:cm_trmm_l_r_artisan }
									add = 1
								}

									limit = { local_var:cm_trmm_l_r_naval = local_var:cm_trmm_l_r_brewing }
									add = 1

						set_local_variable = {
							name = cm_trmm_l_ties
							value = {
								value = 0
								if = {
									limit = { local_var:cm_trmm_l_r_textile = local_var:cm_trmm_l_r_weaponry }
									add = 1
								}
								if = {
									limit = { local_var:cm_trmm_l_r_textile = local_var:cm_trmm_l_r_book }
									add = 1
								}
								if = {
									limit = { local_var:cm_trmm_l_r_textile = local_var:cm_trmm_l_r_artisan }
									add = 1
								}
								if = {
									limit = { local_var:cm_trmm_l_r_textile = local_var:cm_trmm_l_r_brewing }
									add = 1
								}
								if = {
									limit = { local_var:cm_trmm_l_r_textile = local_var:cm_trmm_l_r_masonry }
									add = 1
								}
							}
						}
						if = {
							limit = { local_var:cm_trmm_l_ties >= 2 }
							set_variable = {
								name = cm_trmm_tie_idx
								value = 10
							}
						}
						else_if = {
							limit = { local_var:cm_trmm_l_r_textile = local_var:cm_trmm_l_r_weaponry }
							set_variable = {
								name = cm_trmm_tie_idx
								value = 5
							}
						}
						else_if = {
							limit = { local_var:cm_trmm_l_r_textile = local_var:cm_trmm_l_r_book }
							set_variable = {
								name = cm_trmm_tie_idx
								value = 4
							}
						}
						else_if = {
							limit = { local_var:cm_trmm_l_r_textile = local_var:cm_trmm_l_r_artisan }
							set_variable = {
								name = cm_trmm_tie_idx
								value = 3
							}
						}
						else_if = {
							limit = { local_var:cm_trmm_l_r_textile = local_var:cm_trmm_l_r_brewing }
							set_variable = {
								name = cm_trmm_tie_idx
								value = 2

									add = 1

								if = {

									add = 1
								}
								if = {
									limit = { local_var:cm_trmm_l_r_weaponry = local_var:cm_trmm_l_r_masonry }
									add = 1

							limit = { local_var:cm_trmm_l_ties >= 2 }
							set_variable = {
								name = cm_trmm_tie_idx
								value = 10
							}
						}
						else_if = {
							limit = { local_var:cm_trmm_l_r_weaponry = local_var:cm_trmm_l_r_book }
							set_variable = {
								name = cm_trmm_tie_idx
								value = 4
							}
						}
						else_if = {
							limit = { local_var:cm_trmm_l_r_weaponry = local_var:cm_trmm_l_r_artisan }
							set_variable = {
								name = cm_trmm_tie_idx
								value = 3
							}
						}
						else_if = {
							limit = { local_var:cm_trmm_l_r_weaponry = local_var:cm_trmm_l_r_brewing }
							set_variable = {
								name = cm_trmm_tie_idx
								value = 2
							}
						}
						else_if = {
							limit = { local_var:cm_trmm_l_r_weaponry = local_var:cm_trmm_l_r_masonry }
							set_variable = {
								name = cm_trmm_tie_idx
								value = 1
							}
						}
					}
					else_if = {
						limit = { var:cm_trmm_best_idx = 4 }
						set_local_variable = {
							name = cm_trmm_l_ties
							value = {
								value = 0
								if = {
									limit = { local_var:cm_trmm_l_r_book = local_var:cm_trmm_l_r_artisan }
									add = 1
								}
								if = {
									limit = { local_var:cm_trmm_l_r_book = local_var:cm_trmm_l_r_brewing }
									add = 1
								}
								if = {
									limit = { local_var:cm_trmm_l_r_book = local_var:cm_trmm_l_r_masonry }
									add = 1
								}
							}
						}
						if = {
							limit = { local_var:cm_trmm_l_ties >= 2 }
							set_variable = {
								name = cm_trmm_tie_idx
								value = 10
							}
						}
						else_if = {
							limit = { local_var:cm_trmm_l_r_book = local_var:cm_trmm_l_r_artisan }
							set_variable = {
								name = cm_trmm_tie_idx
								value = 3
							}
						}
						else_if = {
							limit = { local_var:cm_trmm_l_r_book = local_var:cm_trmm_l_r_brewing }
							set_variable = {
								name = cm_trmm_tie_idx
								value = 2
							}
						}
						else_if = {
							limit = { local_var:cm_trmm_l_r_book = local_var:cm_trmm_l_r_masonry }
							set_variable = {
								name = cm_trmm_tie_idx
								value = 1
							}
						}
					}
					else_if = {
						limit = { var:cm_trmm_best_idx = 3 }
						set_local_variable = {
							name = cm_trmm_l_ties
							value = {
								value = 0
								if = {
									limit = { local_var:cm_trmm_l_r_artisan = local_var:cm_trmm_l_r_brewing }
									add = 1
								}
								if = {
									limit = { local_var:cm_trmm_l_r_artisan = local_var:cm_trmm_l_r_masonry }
									add = 1
								}
							}
						}
						if = {
							limit = { local_var:cm_trmm_l_ties >= 2 }
							set_variable = {
								name = cm_trmm_tie_idx
								value = 10
							}
						}
						else_if = {
							limit = { local_var:cm_trmm_l_r_artisan = local_var:cm_trmm_l_r_brewing }
							set_variable = {
								name = cm_trmm_tie_idx
								value = 2
							}
						}
						else_if = {
							limit = { local_var:cm_trmm_l_r_artisan = local_var:cm_trmm_l_r_masonry }
							set_variable = {
								name = cm_trmm_tie_idx
								value = 1
							}
						}
					}
					else_if = {
						limit = { var:cm_trmm_best_idx = 2 }
						if = {
							limit = { local_var:cm_trmm_l_r_brewing = local_var:cm_trmm_l_r_masonry }
							set_variable = {
								name = cm_trmm_tie_idx
								value = 1
							}
						}
					}
				}
			}
		}
	}
	else = {
		every_province_in_province_definition = {
			every_location_in_province = {
				if = {
					limit = { has_variable = cm_trmm_best_idx }
					remove_variable = cm_trmm_best_idx
				}
				if = {
					limit = { has_variable = cm_trmm_best_mil }
					remove_variable = cm_trmm_best_mil
				}
				if = {
					limit = { has_variable = cm_trmm_tie_idx }
					remove_variable = cm_trmm_tie_idx
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

cm_trmm_recompute_all = {
	every_province_definition = {
		cm_trmm_recompute_province_definition = yes
	}
}

# Turns on auto-expand for the industries a right boosts, and for its raw
# goods where the location produces them. Each industry registers its chain's
# base tier; the obsolete-registration migration resolves it to the current
# tier. Root is the location, expects scope:cm_country.
cm_trmm_enable_expands_tooling = {
	building_type:tools_guild = { save_scope_as = cm_building_type }
	cm_enable_auto_expand_for_building_type = yes
}
cm_trmm_enable_expands_jewelry = {
	building_type:jewelry_guild = { save_scope_as = cm_building_type }
	cm_enable_auto_expand_for_building_type = yes
}
cm_trmm_enable_expands_naval = {
	building_type:naval_supplies_guild = { save_scope_as = cm_building_type }
	cm_enable_auto_expand_for_building_type = yes
	if = {
		limit = { OR = { vegetation = woods vegetation = forest vegetation = jungle raw_material ?= goods:lumber } }
		building_type:tar_kiln = { save_scope_as = cm_building_type }
		cm_enable_auto_expand_for_building_type = yes
	}
}
cm_trmm_enable_expands_textile = {
	building_type:cloth_guild = { save_scope_as = cm_building_type }
	cm_enable_auto_expand_for_building_type = yes
	building_type:dyes_guild = { save_scope_as = cm_building_type }
	cm_enable_auto_expand_for_building_type = yes
	building_type:fine_cloth_guild = { save_scope_as = cm_building_type }
	cm_enable_auto_expand_for_building_type = yes
	if = {
		limit = { raw_material ?= goods:dyes }
		cm_enable_auto_expand_for_rgo = yes
	}
}
cm_trmm_enable_expands_weaponry = {
	building_type:cannon_maker = { save_scope_as = cm_building_type }
	cm_enable_auto_expand_for_building_type = yes
	building_type:gun_smith = { save_scope_as = cm_building_type }
	cm_enable_auto_expand_for_building_type = yes
	building_type:weapon_guild = { save_scope_as = cm_building_type }
	cm_enable_auto_expand_for_building_type = yes
}
cm_trmm_enable_expands_book = {
	building_type:dyes_guild = { save_scope_as = cm_building_type }
	cm_enable_auto_expand_for_building_type = yes
	building_type:paper_guild = { save_scope_as = cm_building_type }
	cm_enable_auto_expand_for_building_type = yes
	building_type:scriptorium = { save_scope_as = cm_building_type }
	cm_enable_auto_expand_for_building_type = yes
	if = {
		limit = { raw_material ?= goods:dyes }
		cm_enable_auto_expand_for_rgo = yes
	}
}
cm_trmm_enable_expands_artisan = {
	building_type:furniture_guild = { save_scope_as = cm_building_type }
	cm_enable_auto_expand_for_building_type = yes
	building_type:pottery_guild = { save_scope_as = cm_building_type }
	cm_enable_auto_expand_for_building_type = yes
	building_type:tannery = { save_scope_as = cm_building_type }
	cm_enable_auto_expand_for_building_type = yes
}
cm_trmm_enable_expands_brewing = {
	building_type:brewery = { save_scope_as = cm_building_type }
	cm_enable_auto_expand_for_building_type = yes
	building_type:distillers_guild = { save_scope_as = cm_building_type }
	cm_enable_auto_expand_for_building_type = yes
	building_type:winery = { save_scope_as = cm_building_type }
	cm_enable_auto_expand_for_building_type = yes
	if = {
		limit = { raw_material ?= goods:wine }
		cm_enable_auto_expand_for_rgo = yes
	}
}
cm_trmm_enable_expands_masonry = {
	if = {
		limit = { is_produced_in_location_market = goods:sand }
		building_type:glass_guild = { save_scope_as = cm_building_type }
		cm_enable_auto_expand_for_building_type = yes
	}
	building_type:mason = { save_scope_as = cm_building_type }
	cm_enable_auto_expand_for_building_type = yes
}
